requirements.evidence: Locale/name pins in .env.example:6,14 and phpunit.xml:22-24; theme config at config/mail.php:128-132; translated subjects added at lang/pt_BR.json:559,804; resend flow always flashes the same status (PasswordResetLinkController.php:35); reset validation and remember_token rotation at NewPasswordController.php:35,41-46; verification id/hash check at VerifyEmailController.php:22-23; routes/routers at routes/web.php:16-31. Gaps: nothing in the diff makes App\Models\User implement MustVerifyEmail, and broker/status messages stay English (no lang/pt_BR/passwords.php).

conventions.evidence: Tests ship with the code (tests/Feature/AccountEmailsTest.php:17-136) per the TDD rule; CHANGELOG updated at CHANGELOG.md:26; inline $request->validate is used consistently (PasswordResetLinkController.php:29-31, NewPasswordController.php:32-36); Bulma markup with escaped values and label/for + autocomplete (forgot-password.blade.php:29-39). Deviations: three-field password rule inline instead of a Form Request, and the auth pages duplicate their HTML shell instead of an anonymous Blade component.

security.evidence: All input is validated (NewPasswordController.php:32-36); output escaped with {{ }} including the token and e-mail (reset-password.blade.php:27-39); CSRF on both forms (forgot-password.blade.php:29); enumeration-safe response (PasswordResetLinkController.php:33-35); signed route plus hash_equals id/e-mail check (VerifyEmailController.php:22-23, routes/web.php:29-31); forceFill only touches password/remember_token (NewPasswordController.php:41-44). Weakness: the password is force-filled in plaintext trusting the unshown User `hashed` cast (NewPasswordController.php:42).

tests.evidence: Pest feature tests cover config/theme (tests/Feature/AccountEmailsTest.php:17-22), both mail subjects/bodies/brand colour (29-40), guest-only form (43-46), enumeration and validation (48-62), form prefill (64-69), successful reset incl. hashing, remember_token and PasswordReset event (71-87), bad token/weak passwords/confirmation (89-109), and 403 for wrong hash/id/unsigned URLs (121-136). Missing: throttle coverage (routes/web.php:20,30) and a test that the VerifyEmail notification URL is the signed `verification.verify` route (tests/Feature/AccountEmailsTest.php:113 builds it by hand).

simplicity.evidence: Reuses the framework's Password broker, ResetPassword/VerifyEmail notifications and the standard copy-and-recolor markdown theme (pegafila.css:1-297, brand at 612-618); no speculative abstractions. Duplication: both auth views repeat the same ~50-line head/body scaffolding (forgot-password.blade.php:1-17 vs reset-password.blade.php:1-17) which an anonymous component could share (layouts are out of scope).

readability.evidence: Small focused controller methods with short docblocks and clear names (PasswordResetLinkController.php:12-36, NewPasswordController.php:16-58, VerifyEmailController.php:47-52); tests read as specifications (tests/Feature/AccountEmailsTest.php:48-87); views are plain, consistent Bulma markup. Only cosmetic nit: stray double blank line at tests/Feature/AccountEmailsTest.php:15-16.

scope.evidence: Every file in the diff serves the task: .env.example:6,14, phpunit.xml:22-24, config/mail.php:128-132, routes/web.php:16-31, the three controllers, two auth views, lang entries (lang/pt_BR.json:559,804), the theme CSS and one test file plus the CHANGELOG entry (CHANGELOG.md:26). No login/registration, Livewire, SCSS/JS, Docker or layout changes.

issues.explanation: Nothing in the change makes the User model implement MustVerifyEmail, so unless it already does, sendEmailVerificationNotification() would send nothing and the VerifyEmail mail the task describes would never be delivered.
Only JSON entries were added, so __('passwords.sent') and __($status) fall back to English lang/en/passwords.php; the status flash rendered on the pt-BR pages stays in English.

The new password is force-filled in plaintext and relies on the User model's `password => hashed` cast, which is not part of the diff; if that cast is absent the reset stores plaintext passwords (only the Hash::check assertion at tests/Feature/AccountEmailsTest.php:84 hints it exists).
The required throttle:6,1 on password.email (and the throttled verification route) is never exercised, so a regression in the rate limiting would not be caught.

The test builds its own signed verification URL instead of asserting the VerifyEmail notification generates the signed `verification.verify` URL required by the task, so the notification-to-route wiring is untested.
Three fields with a shared complex password rule are validated inline; the convention asks for a Form Request once rules grow beyond one or two fields.
The full HTML head/Bulma setup is duplicated in reset-password.blade.php:1-17; a small anonymous component (layouts being out of scope) would remove the copy-paste.
The Bulma convention asks UI-rendering tests to assert accessible labels, but the view tests only check status and prefilled values, never the label/for or autocomplete attributes.
A stray double blank line after uses(RefreshDatabase::class) is the only style blemish in an otherwise clean file.

review.summary: The change delivers the pt-BR password-reset and e-mail-verification account mails: config/phpunit locale pins, a PegaFila markdown theme with #0f7490 on the action button, the five named routes and controllers, the two auth views, the two missing lang entries and a solid Pest feature suite. It is approvable with nits; the main open points are that User's MustVerifyEmail is not visible in the diff, broker/status messages remain English, and password hashing relies on an unshown model cast.
